summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the exhortation, repeated emphasis, negation, offspring promises, speaker attribution, and unstated object of receiving. Reader-facing “servants” and contextual “repentance” follow current policy. The notes distinguish restorations and printed conjectures from preserved readings and accurately disclose the reported gentleness and seed alternatives without displacing the working readings. Acceptance is limited to the supplied source and attributed reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
